contract.association_note: The public CSVs identify vendor and product, but do not carry the purchase-agreement ID for each order.

methodology.scope: 2026 orders for vendor account 002166 with at least one main diesel tank-wagon or transport line.
methodology.ordered_gallons: Sum of main diesel fuel PO line quantities only; excludes tax, winterizer, and biodiesel lines.
methodology.po_total: Sum of all listed PO line amounts, including other fuel, additive, and tax lines on a selected order.
methodology.invoice_total: Sum of unique posted invoice IDs for the selected PO in the loaded year's journal.
methodology.difference: Posted invoice total minus listed PO line total; a difference is not proof of a billing error.
methodology.summary_totals: Totals sum available values only. Coverage counts state how many orders have each underlying value.
methodology.unmatched: No matching invoice in the loaded year's public file; invoices may appear in another year.
methodology.limits: No delivery tickets, scanned invoice PDFs, or proprietary daily contract index are provided. PO dates and gallons do not prove physical delivery.
